digest.component_or_area: CLI bridge commands and schema registry
propositions: The file-backed bridge-status handler and purge-bridge command implementations were removed in change 1517 and must remain absent.
Hidden compatibility alias routes legacy `rebar bridge-status` spelling to canonical durable `rebar bridge status` operation while purge-bridge stays fully retired.
Schema registry exports, constants, output-schema entries, and help documentation must remove all bridge-status and purge-bridge references while preserving durable bridge_status consumers.
Warning messages in reads_cli.py and output.py must replace bridge-status references with neutral bridge-alert guidance and avoid naming retired or not-yet-shipped commands.
Both retired commands must exit as unknown and remain absent from top-level help and active documentation (cli-reference.md, exit-codes.md, output-schemas.md).
